statement: The inspected Wine winebus udev backend enumerates HID/hidraw and Linux input device nodes and derives a USB controller identity/path from its USB parent where one exists. Those paths set up Windows-visible input device identities; they do not contain an audio endpoint lookup or a controller-to-audio-device association. This is a bounded file-level statement, not a conclusion about Wine MMDevAPI, PulseAudio, ALSA, Proton or other components.

applicability.scope: Wine winebus udev source ~1158-1210, ~1385-1420, ~1600-1680 and earlier main.c; no MMDevAPI internals inspected.
